instructions: Follow docs/AGENT_CONTEXT.md and AGENTS.md. Prioritize authZ, tenancy, secret leakage, unsafe client errors, and emulator/production safety over style nits. Style is largely covered by Prettier and ESLint.

rules.rule: Local and everyday agent work must use Firebase emulators (NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR and emulator host env vars). Do not introduce defaults that point the app at production Firebase for local development.
Never commit secrets (.env, .env.local, service account JSON, API keys, QStash/Plunk/OAuth/SEED/CRON secrets). Flag any added credential material or hardcoded secret values.

Privileged or mutating API routes must authenticate with lib/api/auth.ts helpers (verifyAuth, verifySuperUser, verifyClubAdmin, verifyClubAdminForMatch, or membership helpers). Do not invent ad-hoc token parsing or skip auth for convenience.

API error responses shown to clients must use sanitizeErrorForClient (lib/api/sanitizeError.ts) or an equivalent safe fallback. Never return raw Firebase/Firestore messages or stack traces to the client.
Club-scoped data must not become readable or writable across clubs without an explicit super_user (or equivalent) gate. Prefer club_admin / membership checks when a resource has clubId.
Cron handlers must verify QStash signatures and/or CRON_SECRET. Seed and destructive debug endpoints must remain gated (verifySuperUser and/or SEED_SECRET) and must not become publicly callable.
Client Firestore uses the Lite SDK by design. Do not switch to the full client SDK or add onSnapshot Listen streams without an explicit product decision and mobile regression plan.
Team generation, transfers, and other trusted business rules belong in API routes / server lib, not reimplemented as sole authority on the client. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
